items.title: Nogic – VS Code extension that visualizes your codebase as a graph
items.raw_excerpt: I built Nogic, a VSCode extension currently, because AI tools make code grow faster than developers can build a mental model by jumping between files. Exploring structure visually has been helping me onboard to unfamiliar codebases faster. It’s early and rough, but usable. Would love feedback on whether this is useful and what relationships are most valuable to visualize.

items.title: 直播预告：新瓶旧酒还是涅槃重生？操作系统的 AI 进化终将走向何方？|《AI 进化论》第八期
items.raw_excerpt: 在 AI 与本土化双重浪潮之下，服务器操作系统正迎来历史性变革。由龙蜥社区理事长单位阿里云联合 InfoQ 打造的直播 IP 栏目《AI 进化论：智算时代操作系统的破局之路》，以云、AI、安全等技术与服务器操作系统如何融合演进为主线，聚焦服务器操作系统在智算时代的进化之路，特邀学术权威、行业专家、客户代表围绕原生智能、原生安全、软硬协同等热点议题展开深度对话。截至目前，已直播七期，线上观看人次达 60 万+。

title_i18n.zh: 直播预告：新瓶旧酒还是涅槃重生？操作系统的 AI 进化终将走向何方？|《AI 进化论》第八期
title_i18n.en: Live Preview: Old Wine in New Bottles or Rebirth from Ashes? Where Will the AI Evolution of Operating Systems Ultimately Lead? | "AI Evolution Theory" Episode 8
title_i18n.es: Próximo directo: ¿Vino viejo en botella nueva o renacimiento? ¿Hacia dónde se dirige la evolución de la IA en los sistemas operativos? | "Teoría de la Evolución de la IA", octava edición.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 在 AI 与本土化双重浪潮之下，服务器操作系统正迎来历史性变革。由龙蜥社区理事长单位阿里云联合 InfoQ 打造的直播 IP 栏目《AI 进化论：智算时代操作系统的破局之路》，以云、AI、安全等技术与服务器操作系统如何融合演进为主线，聚焦服务器操作系统在智算时代的进化之路，特邀学术权威、行业专家、客户代表围绕原生智能、原生安全、软硬协同等热点议题展开深度对话。截至目前，已直播七期，线上观看人次达 60 万+。
excerpt_i18n.en: Amidst the dual waves of AI and localization, server operating systems are undergoing a historic transformation. The live-streaming series "AI Evolution: The Path to Breakthroughs in Operating Systems for the Intelligent Computing Era," created by Alibaba Cloud, the governing unit of the OpenAnolis community, in collaboration with InfoQ, explores the integration and evolution of technologies such as cloud, AI, and security with server operating systems. It focuses on the evolutionary journey of server operating systems in the intelligent computing era, featuring in-depth discussions with academic authorities, industry experts, and customer representatives on hot topics like native intelligence, native security, and software-hardware synergy. To date, seven episodes have been streamed, with over 600,000 online views.
excerpt_i18n.es: Bajo la doble ola de la IA y la localización, los sistemas operativos de servidor están experimentando una transformación histórica. La serie de transmisiones en vivo "Evolución de la IA: El camino hacia la ruptura de los sistemas operativos en la era de la computación inteligente", creada por Alibaba Cloud, unidad principal de la comunidad OpenAnolis, en colaboración con InfoQ, se centra en cómo las tecnologías como la nube, la IA y la seguridad se integran y evolucionan con los sistemas operativos de servidor, explorando su desarrollo en la era de la computación inteligente. La serie invita a autoridades académicas, expertos de la industria y representantes de clientes a dialogar en profundidad sobre temas candentes como la inteligencia nativa, la seguridad nativa y la colaboración entre software y hardware. Hasta la fecha, se han transmitido siete episodios, con más de 600,000 visualizaciones en línea.

items.title: How do you apply for jobs in the age of AI?
items.raw_excerpt: With AI being used by applicants to spam-apply to any open positions, and recruiters using AI as a filter, it feels like there's a lot of noise and few humans in the system right now. I thought about simply doing the same (building some n8n automation, or using one of the countless find-a-job-and-apply AI tools on GitHub), but I think there's a better way to do all of this - maybe even by getting around all of this AI shitshow?! Things I was thinking about: - don't optimize the CV/motivational letter with AI so that it sounds authentic - do unsolicited applications at companies i find interesting (since no job posting is open, no AI will suggest this company - and probably the recruiter will read the application) - do more networking (i hate that shit but IK its the most effective)

title_i18n.en: How do you apply for jobs in the age of AI?

title_i18n.es: ¿Cómo se solicita empleo en la era de la inteligencia artificial?

excerpt_i18n.en: With AI being used by applicants to spam-apply to any open positions, and recruiters using AI as a filter, it feels like there's a lot of noise and few humans in the system right now. I thought about simply doing the same (building some n8n automation, or using one of the countless find-a-job-and-apply AI tools on GitHub), but I think there's a better way to do all of this - maybe even by getting around all of this AI shitshow?! Things I was thinking about: - don't optimize the CV/motivational letter with AI so that it sounds authentic - do unsolicited applications at companies i find interesting (since no job posting is open, no AI will suggest this company - and probably the recruiter will read the application) - do more networking (i hate that shit but IK its the most effective)
excerpt_i18n.zh: 随着求职者利用AI海投所有空缺职位，招聘方也以AI作为筛选工具，当前系统中似乎充斥着大量噪音，而人为参与却寥寥无几。我曾考虑过干脆效仿此法。
excerpt_i18n.es: Con los solicitantes usando IA para enviar solicitudes masivas a cualquier puesto vacante, y los reclutadores usando IA como filtro, parece que hay mucho ruido y pocos humanos en el sistema actualmente. Pensé en simplemente hacer lo mismo.

items.title: The Joy of Not Learning: How AI Saves My Hobby Projects
items.raw_excerpt: I am not entirely sure if there is an AI bubble or not. People much smarter than me would have more nuanced views on that. I am not sure if AI will revolutionize the workplace, end world hunger, or stop climate change in its tracks. But one thing is for sure: it has had an impact on learning. Specifically, my learning. Even more specifically, what I need not learn.

items.title: OSS AI agent that indexes and searches the Epstein files
items.raw_excerpt:
Hi HN, I built an open-source AI agent that has already indexed and can search the entire Epstein files, roughly 100M words of publicly released documents. The goal was simple: make a large, messy corpus of PDFs and text files immediately searchable in a precise way, without relying on keyword search or bloated prompts. What it does: - The full dataset is already indexed
- You can ask natural language questions
- Answers are grounded and include direct references to source documents
- Supports both exact text lookup and semantic search Discussion around these files is often fragmented. This makes it possible to explore the primary sources directly and verify claims without manually digging through thousands of pages. Happy to answer questions or go into technical details. Code: https://git
